claims.claim_text: The indexed Sergeant George H. Babcock is confirmed in the official Army enlistment table.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact name and a private identifier match between the OSS index and the official Army enlistment table.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact name and an exact unique private identifier across two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The enlistment record documents Army entry from civil life as a private in March 1943; the later Sergeant rank is compatible with advancement.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is not quoted or exposed. The official occupation field is an undefined code, so no occupation or employer is assigned.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Thomas Babin is a high-confidence match to the Thomas Babin whom official VENONA descriptions place with an OSS unit in July 1943.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Thomas Babin is going to Cairo with OSS unit
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Two official NSA item descriptions identify Thomas Babin in direct OSS-unit and OSS-associate context in July 1943.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name in the official OSS index and two highly specific official NSA descriptions, independently supported by a scholarly history.
claims.temporal_assessment: The official descriptions place Thomas Babin with an OSS unit in July 1943 but do not establish the date he entered OSS.
claims.match_notes: Box 28 remains unreviewed, so the identity is high confidence rather than confirmed by a personnel-file linkage.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 28 for George H. Babcock's Army-to-OSS chronology, immediate military assignment, and any named civilian employer. The official occupation code is undefined, so no occupation is assigned.
